columns.description: Identifier of the usage row.

columns.name: evidence_id

columns.name: src
columns.description: The subscriber number.

columns.name: imei
columns.description: Handset identity, when recorded.

columns.name: app_category
columns.description: Category of the application.

columns.name: app
columns.description: Application name as classified by the provider.

columns.name: app_feature

columns.name: start_utc
columns.description: Start of the usage record, UTC.

columns.name: end_utc
columns.description: End of the usage record, UTC.

columns.name: province

columns.name: city

views.name: v_cell_visits
views.description: Per subscriber, cell and hour: the number of events, with the cell name, position and radius. For where a number was and when.

columns.name: src
columns.description: The subscriber.

columns.name: cell_key
columns.description: The cell the events were served by.

columns.name: hour_utc
columns.description: The hour (UTC) the events fall in.

columns.name: events
columns.description: Number of events of the subscriber on that cell in that hour.

columns.name: site_name
columns.description: Name of the cell site.

columns.name: lat
columns.description: Latitude of the site.

columns.name: lon
columns.description: Longitude of the site.

columns.name: radius_m
columns.description: Stated coverage radius in metres.

views.name: v_cells
views.description: Cell sites known to the case: name, position and the stated coverage radius. The case's own list wins, then the tenant-wide one; for a cell neither describes, the position is the average of the positions the records themselves give it (no name, and a radius only if the records state one). A cell is not a position of a person; show the radius with any location claim.

columns.name: cell_key
columns.description: Canonical cell key; joins to v_comm_events.cell_key and v_cell_visits.cell_key.

columns.name: site_name
columns.description: Name of the site, when known.

columns.name: operator
columns.description: Operator that runs the cell.

columns.name: lat
columns.description: Latitude of the site, degrees.

columns.name: lon
columns.description: Longitude of the site, degrees.

columns.name: radius_m
columns.description: Stated coverage radius in metres. A phone is somewhere within roughly this distance, not at the point.

views.name: v_comm_events
views.description: Calls and SMS of the target call records, one row per event, repeats excluded, times in UTC. src is the subscriber whose records these are; dst is the other party.

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: Identifier of the event row.

columns.name: evidence_id
columns.description: The evidence file the row came from; use it to cite the source.

columns.name: source_row
columns.description: Row number in the source file, counting from 0.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: voice, sms, mms, data, ussd or other.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: outgoing, incoming, none or unknown, as the provider recorded it.

columns.name: src
columns.description: The subscriber number whose records these are (digits, normalised).

columns.name: dst
columns.description: The other party: a normalised number, or a short code, sender name or service label as written. Null when the file gives no usable counterparty (a sentinel value, the subscriber itself).

columns.name: dst_kind
columns.description: Class of the other party: person_like, international, short_code, sender_id, service_label or unknown.

columns.name: dst_is_person_like
columns.description: True when the other party is an ordinary or international number; false for short codes, sender names and services.

columns.name: start_utc
columns.description: Start of the event as a UTC instant. The case clock is Asia/Karachi: convert with AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Karachi' for local times.

columns.name: end_utc
columns.description: End of the event as a UTC instant, when recorded.

columns.name: duration_s
columns.description: Duration in seconds, when recorded.

columns.name: imsi
columns.description: SIM identity seen with the event, when recorded.

columns.name: imei
columns.description: Handset identity seen with the event, when recorded.

columns.name: cell_key
columns.description: Key of the serving cell, joins to v_cells.cell_key; null when the file gives no cell.

columns.name: time_basis
columns.description: How the source time zone is known: declared, assumed_by_profile, confirmed_by_analyst or explicit_offset.

columns.name: source_tz
columns.description: The time zone the source file was written in.

views.name: v_connection_edges
views.description: How two numbers are connected, through calls and messages in either direction, within three links: ask for a pair with a = first number AND b = second number. Each row is one link (src to dst) of a path from a to b; hops is how many links the path has (1 direct, 2 through one shared contact, 3 through two numbers); ordinary is true when no link of the path goes to a service or through a number everyone contacts; rank_any = 1 marks the shortest paths, rank_ordinary = 1 the shortest ordinary paths. Use for connected, connection, path, link, chain, route, shared contact, how are A and B related, within N hops (up to 3).

columns.name: a
columns.description: The first number of the pair asked about: always write a = '...' in the query.

columns.name: b
columns.description: The second number of the pair asked about: always write b = '...' in the query.

columns.name: src
columns.description: One end of a link of a path from a to b.

columns.name: dst
columns.description: The other end of that link.

columns.name: hops
columns.description: Number of links of the path the row belongs to: 1 direct contact, 2 through one shared contact, 3 through two numbers.

columns.name: ordinary
columns.description: True when no link of the path goes to a service or through a number everyone contacts; use it when the question leaves services and hubs out.

columns.name: rank_any
columns.description: 1 for the shortest paths between a and b, 2 for the next length, and so on.

columns.name: rank_ordinary
columns.description: 1 for the shortest ORDINARY paths (null for a path that is not ordinary); use rank_ordinary = 1 with ordinary when services and hubs are left out.

views.name: v_contact_links
views.description: Every contact of the case as an undirected link between two numbers (both orders are present), with the number of events and whether the link is ordinary: neither to a service nor through a number everyone contacts. The building block of v_connection_edges.

columns.name: a
columns.description: One of the two numbers of the link; each link is present in both orders.

columns.name: b
columns.description: The other number of the link.

columns.name: ordinary
columns.description: True when the link comes from an ordinary contact: neither to a service nor to a number everyone contacts.

columns.name: events
columns.description: Number of events between the two numbers, both directions together.

views.name: v_contact_pairs
views.description: One row per subscriber (src) and other party (dst): event counts by direction, total duration, first and last contact. Use is_service and is_hub to leave out short codes, sender names and numbers that everyone contacts.

columns.name: src
columns.description: The subscriber whose records these are.

columns.name: dst
columns.description: The other party.

columns.name: is_service
columns.description: True when the other party is not an ordinary or international number: a short code, a sender name, a service label.

columns.name: is_hub
columns.description: True when the other party is in contact with more than the case's threshold of distinct subscribers (app.hub_threshold, 20 when unset): a number everyone contacts.

columns.name: events
columns.description: Number of events between the two.

columns.name: outgoing
columns.description: Events recorded as outgoing.

columns.name: incoming
columns.description: Events recorded as incoming.

columns.name: unknown
columns.description: Events whose direction is none or unknown.

columns.name: total_duration_s
columns.description: Sum of the durations in seconds over all events (null when none was recorded).

columns.name: first_seen
columns.description: Time of the first event, UTC.

columns.name: last_seen
columns.description: Time of the last event, UTC.

columns.name: imsi

columns.name: public_port_from

columns.name: server_ip

columns.name: start_utc

columns.name: holds_to

columns.name: app_category
columns.description: Category of the application, as classified by the provider.

columns.name: app
columns.description: Application, as classified by the provider (a vendor label, not content).

columns.name: host

columns.name: imsi

views.name: v_evidence_inventory
views.description: The evidence files of the case, one row each: name, modality (image, audio, video, document, structured_records), detected type, extension, size, processing status and time added. For how many files, images, documents or recordings the case holds, and which failed.

columns.name: evidence_id
columns.description: Identifier of the evidence item.

columns.name: original_filename
columns.description: File name as it was added.

columns.name: modality
columns.description: image, audio, video, document or structured_records.

columns.name: detected_type
columns.description: What the file was recognised as: cdr, ipdr, anpr, subscriber, transaction, access_log, tower_location, pdf, image, audio, video, document or generic.

columns.name: extension
columns.description: File extension.

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.description: Size of the file in bytes.

columns.name: processing_status
columns.description: completed, failed or still processing.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: When the item was added to the case, UTC.
